Aria: Quick sprint deploy docket check — putting up the tentative lineup for Thursday UTC. Trying to keep this compact.
Aria: Proposed slots: 14:00 UTC webapi (Jamal), 14:30 UTC routing (Sasha), 15:00 UTC embeddings-lite (Mike). Each slot 20m with 10m smoke window.
Aria: Ping if you need to swap or require extra rollback prep. I will update the deploy board after confirmations. :white_check_mark:
Jamal: I can take webapi at 14:00. I’ll own smoke and rollback tag. Will run the usual smoke script.
Sasha: Routing slot ack, but note the schema migration for route-mapping lands 13:50 — can we move my slot to 14:40 so migrations finish and we have a clean KV warmup?
Mike: embeddings-lite ok for 15:00, but the quantized artifact build is delayed ~15m. If Sasha shifts to 14:40 I can keep 15:00.
Aria: ok moving routing to 14:40 and embeddings to 15:00. Jamal still at 14:00. Updated on my side.
Jamal: +1. Also FYI I’ll run the TTL-cleaner off path before my deploy, reduces cold-start noise.
Sasha: I’ll coordinate with DB migrations — I’ll place a migration flag in the deploy notes. If anyone sees long tail errors during canary, rollback rule is immediate revert + database migration flag rollback.
Mike: For embeddings smoke, I’ll run the quick embed sanity check: ```bash
curl -sS -X POST https://smoke.redwood.internal/embeddings-lite/check -d '{"sample":"test"}'
```
Mike: Expect ~2m check. If vectors stop matching baseline >5% we abort.
Aria: ops-bot can you paste the smoke checklist link and deploy board url here?
ops-bot: Deploy checklist: https://confluence.redwood/ops/deploy-checklist — Deploy board: https://board.redwood/releases/slot/2026-04-17
deploy-bot: Scheduled: webapi @14:00 (Jamal), routing @14:40 (Sasha), embeddings-lite @15:00 (Mike). Reminders set: 15m/5m before slot.
Jamal: Quick ask — who’s looping on post-deploy customer smoke? I can grab it for webapi if Mike wants embeddings.
Mike: I’ll take embeddings post-deploy verification for first 30m.
Sasha: I’ll monitor routing metrics and hit the rollback if 5xx spike + latency >100ms for the canary window.
Aria: Perfect. Last items: ensure rollback playbooks are pinned, and owners have `canary:owner` tag on the board. I’ll do a final pass 1h before. :rocket:
Jamal: All good from my side.
Sasha: Good here.
Mike: All set, will push artifact by 14:10 UTC.
Aria: Thanks — I’ll send final confirmation 1h out and create the handoff thread for post-smoke notes.
Aria: (defer to deploy-bot for live status updates during deploys)
